acceptance_criteria: The profile delete confirmation has a field 'Zum Bestätigen den Namen „<name>“ eingeben'; 'Endgültig löschen' is aria-disabled and does nothing until the typed text equals the stored name (NFC, trimmed, case-sensitive)
The 2-second hold and release stay as they are once the name matches; Abbrechen and Escape leave as now; a wrong name is said in German without deleting
Spell checking and correction are off on the field; the field gets the focus when the confirmation opens
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: Deleting a child profile needs the profile's name typed before 'Endgültig löschen' can be held, so a child who got into the caregiver area cannot delete a profile by tapping and holding.
non_goals: Deleting own concepts or gesture examples (they keep the hold only)
